description: A sine burst with a fast decay, in the manner of the 808 clave

params.text: Sets the pitch of the sine, 2000Hz to 3500Hz; the tooltip and the manual both quote half those figures
Sets how fast the sine fades, 5ms fully anticlockwise to 25ms fully clockwise
Fires the sound, restarting the sine from zero phase; a rising edge at the trigger jack does it too

inputs.text: A rising edge above 0.5V fires the sound; the length of the gate makes no difference

outputs.text: The sine burst, up to 5V peak

notes: a CV input is bipolar and is added to its knob: 10V there is worth the knob's whole travel, -10V cancels a knob that is fully up, and the total is clamped to the knob's own range
the manual calls the pitch control a bandpass filter cutoff; there is no filter in this module, only a sine oscillator

inputs.0:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.1:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.2:
high above 0.5V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
